ATOMICITY.identical_retry: If a verified committed matching intent and exact effect already exist, return historical committed transaction identity and current verified head without producer invocation, ledger append, state reset or new bundle. If descendants exist, preserve them.

ATOMICITY.precommit_unchanged: Authoritative pre-bundle/state/ledger/HEAD remain byte-identical through all checks and staging failures
ATOMICITY.retry_after_precommit_failure: No admitted event exists; reload same verified parent and run the NON_EFFECTING producer again. Orphan immutable files must match exact bytes or fail; do not silently mutate them.
ATOMICITY.retry_after_uncertain_publication: Read trusted HEAD under lock; exact transaction present => historical no-op success; pre-state still current => new attempt; divergent head/effect => fail
ATOMICITY.retry_effect: Full canonical SuppliedResult, canonical native validation member values, source pin/content inventory and resulting Snapshot/event/bundle identities
ATOMICITY.retry_evidence: If an already-prepared candidate is resubmitted, require exact canonical result/tuple/source effect equality to archived committed operands. A new source/content/result under same intent is conflict, not a fresh command.
ATOMICITY.retry_intent: (trusted expected pre-bundle ID, original parent Snapshot ID, original parent event ID, native ActionId); all are native identities, no new command namespace
ATOMICITY.trusted_readers: Only restore externally trusted bundle identity or validated HEAD; require complete archive/event/source closure and full replay before exposure. Hashes are integrity bindings, not issuer signatures.
ATOMICITY.visibility_boundary: Atomic replacement of HEAD after complete immutable artifact closure and all semantic checks; artifact existence alone is not acceptance
